name: streaming
title: Streaming (server-sent events)
summary: Reads a server-sent event stream as it arrives (multi-byte safe, errors inside a 200 included) and an Ask screen that streams an answer — consent-gated with ai-consent, account-only with guest, switchable with remote-config.
when: An AI chat, a live feed, or any endpoint that answers with `text/event-stream`.
screens: | — | Ask | `/ask?itemId=` | item | — | `POST /ask` (SSE) | thinking, streaming, error, switched off | account + consent when installed |
claudeRules: Streams go through `apiFetch(…, { unscheduled: true })` and `readSseStream` (`src/modules/streaming/sse.ts`); an error can arrive inside a 200, so the stream's own error event is handled too.
